2026.aprilNote: FY begins. Ensure all new registrations (GST, PT, ESIC) are in order. March TDS has a special extended due date of 30th April. Composition dealers: CMP-08 for Q4 (Jan–Mar) due 18th April + GSTR-4 Annual Return due 30th June. 📜 New law: the Income-tax Act, 2025 is now in force — income from 1 April falls under the new Tax Year (replacing Tax Year / Tax Year), and the TDS forms are renumbered: salary certificate is now Form 130 (earlier 16), the annual tax-credit statement is Form 168 (earlier 26AS), and the no-deduction declaration is Form 121 (earlier 15G/15H). Returns filed during this year for the prior year continue on the earlier forms.
2026.ap4: GSTR-4 – Annual Return for Composition Dealers (FY 2025–26)
2026.ap1Penalty: Interest @ 1.5% per month (or part of month) under the Income-tax Act, 2025 from date of deduction to date of deposit. 30% of the payment on which TDS was not deducted is disallowed as a business expense under the Income-tax Act, 2025.
